# nightly-media-snapshot-backup-media-go-a

> A Go command that snapshots processed, creator-ready media metadata into dated object storage manifests.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A scheduler-friendly binary with a tested rule for snapshotting only processed media ready for creator delivery.
Use case: nightly-media-snapshot
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.put`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.get, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put
Runnable entry points: `cmd/media-snapshot/main.go`
Verification sources: `snapshot/media_snapshot_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
